outreach_draft.subject: A thought on your Oil & Gas work
outreach_draft.body:
Marc, I noticed your site clearly positions you for both criminal defense and oil & gas work, and your profile goes into meaningful energy-side services like refinery contracts, joint ventures, regulatory matters, and OILTA escrow support. Right now, though, an oil & gas client is still entering largely through the same general website conversation as a criminal-defense visitor instead of getting a focused destination built around those business needs. A dedicated Oil & Gas Law page could give that client a much clearer path from the first click, while also giving Google and AI systems a cleaner context for what you handle in the energy sector. I’d use Oil & Gas Law as the first mockup because it’s materially different from the criminal-defense side and already has strong service detail to build from. I’m putting together a quick mockup to show you what I mean. I’ll send it over in the next couple of days.

If you’d rather I didn’t, just let me know.
